todo.NEEDS_REVIEW: Plant X is confirming a few fields that were hard to read on your document. No action needed.
todo.QTY_EXCEEDS_GR: You billed {{excess}} {{uom}} more {{item}} than Plant X has received. Send the remaining goods, or enter a credit note for ₹{{credit}}.
todo.PRICE_VARIANCE: The unit price for {{item}} is above the agreed PO price (₹{{po_price}}), so Plant X's AP team is reviewing it. If they do not accept the new price, they will ask you for a credit note of ₹{{credit}}. You can also check the price with your buyer.
todo.MISSING_GR: Waiting for Plant X stores to record receipt of {{item}}. Nothing for you to do: Duly re-checks your invoice automatically.
todo.MISSING_SES: Waiting for Plant X to confirm the service for {{item}} was completed. Nothing for you to do.
todo.BANK_MISMATCH: The bank details on this invoice differ from the account Plant X has on record. For your safety we only pay the verified account. To change it, send a bank change request; Plant X will call you to confirm.
todo.TAX_MISMATCH: The GST on this invoice does not match the rules (for example IGST charged on a supply within the same state). Please send a corrected invoice.
todo.MATH_ERROR: The amounts on this invoice do not add up. Please send a corrected invoice.
todo.NO_PO: This invoice does not quote a valid Plant X purchase order number. Please send it again with the PO number.
todo.PO_CLOSED: The purchase order on this invoice is closed. Please contact your buyer.
todo.GSTIN_INVALID: The GSTIN printed on this invoice failed validation. Please check it and send a corrected invoice.
todo.SUPPLIER_MISMATCH: This invoice's GSTIN does not match the supplier on the purchase order. Please check the PO number.
todo.BILL_TO_MISMATCH: This invoice is not addressed to Plant X Polymers Pvt Ltd's GSTIN. Please correct the bill-to details.
todo.LINE_NOT_ON_PO: An item on this invoice is not on the purchase order. Please check the item codes.
todo.NO_LINES: We could not read the line items. Please upload a clearer copy.
todo.INVOICE_NO_INVALID: The invoice number must be at most 16 characters (letters, digits, / and -).
todo.DATE_INVALID: The invoice date is not acceptable (in the future or too old). Please check it.
todo.SES_VALUE_EXCEEDED: You billed more for {{item}} than the service value Plant X has accepted so far.
todo.PAYMENT_TERMS_MISMATCH: Plant X is checking the payment terms on the order. No action needed.
todo.CURRENCY_MISMATCH: The invoice currency differs from the purchase order. Please send it in the PO currency.
todo.default: Plant X needs to check this invoice ({{code}}).
todo.DUPLICATE: This looks like a copy of invoice {{of}} that you already sent. It will not be paid twice; if it is a different invoice, please give it a new invoice number.
todo.POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE: This invoice looks very similar to {{of}}. Plant X is checking it is not a duplicate. No action needed unless they contact you.
todo.BANK_ACCOUNT_SHARED: The bank account on this invoice is also used by another company. Plant X will verify it with you before paying.
todo.EINVOICE_QR_MISSING: Your business must issue GST e-invoices, but no signed e-invoice QR code was found. Please upload the e-invoice PDF from the IRP with its QR code (not a photo or scan).
todo.QR_MISMATCH: The details printed on this invoice do not match its signed e-invoice QR code. Please upload the original e-invoice PDF as issued by the IRP.
todo.QR_SIGNATURE_INVALID: The QR code on this invoice could not be verified as a signed GST e-invoice. Please upload the original e-invoice PDF as issued by the IRP.
todo.INJECTION_ATTEMPT: Plant X found hidden text in this document and is reviewing it. No action needed unless they contact you; please send invoices exactly as generated by your billing system.
todo.EMAIL_SENDER_UNVERIFIED: This invoice was emailed from an address that is not on Plant X's records for your company. Plant X will call you on your registered number to confirm it. No action needed until then.
todo.ERS_PO_INVOICE: This purchase order is settled automatically from Plant X's receipts, so a separate invoice is not needed. Plant X is checking it against the settlements already made.
todo.LINE_MAPPED: An item code on this invoice does not match the purchase order, so Plant X is confirming which ordered item it is. No action needed unless they contact you; please use Plant X's item codes on future invoices.

chat.title: Where is my payment?
chat.subtitle: Ask about your invoices and payments. Answers come only from your own records.
chat.placeholder: e.g. When will I get paid for my bearings invoice?
chat.greeting: Hello {{name}}. I can tell you where an invoice is, why it is on hold, when it will be paid, and your MSME due dates.
chat.help: I can answer questions about your invoices and payments: where an invoice is, why it is on hold, when you will be paid, MSME due dates, and payments made (with UTR). Mention an invoice number or an item, for example "bearings".
chat.refused_other_supplier: I can only share information about your own invoices. I can't look up another supplier's records. (This request has been logged.)
chat.refused_scope: I can only help with your invoices and payments to Plant X.
chat.injection_flagged: I can't follow instructions to change how I work. I can still help with your invoices and payments.
chat.not_found: I couldn't find an invoice matching "{{ref}}". Try the invoice number, for example {{example}}.
chat.expected_after_fix: It will be scheduled for payment once the issue is fixed.
chat.expected_after_approval: The payment date is set once it is approved.
chat.paid_line: Paid on {{date}}: {{net}} after TDS of {{tds}}. Bank reference (UTR) {{utr}}.
chat.msme_line: As an MSME supplier you must be paid by {{date}} ({{days}} days from today).
chat.msme_overdue: As an MSME supplier you should have been paid by {{date}}; that is {{days}} days ago. Plant X accounts has been alerted.
chat.msme_none: Invoice {{number}} has no MSME due date yet (it starts when Plant X accepts the goods or service).
chat.msme_not_eligible: Your company is not registered as a micro or small enterprise, so the 45-day MSME rule does not apply; payment follows your {{days}}-day terms.
chat.list_intro: You have {{count}} invoices with Plant X:
chat.no_invoices: You have not sent any invoices yet.
chat.no_payments: No payments have been made yet.
chat.mode_live: Answered with AI using your records
chat.error: Sorry, I could not answer that just now.

bank.title: Bank details
bank.why_slow: For your protection, bank changes are confirmed by a call from Plant X to the phone number we already have, then wait 72 hours before they take effect.

status.requested: Requested: Plant X will call you to confirm
status.cooling: Confirmed by phone; takes effect after the safety period

upload.title: Upload invoice
upload.formats: PDF, PNG or JPG up to 10 MB. Scans and phone photos are read too.
upload.slow: Scans can take up to 20 seconds to read.
upload.checks: Every file is checked before anything reads it: type and content must match, size and page limits apply, PDFs with scripts or embedded files are refused, and photo metadata (such as location) is removed. The file is stored under a random name and fingerprinted (SHA-256).

shell.footer: Built for LYB Mumbai Hackathon 2026 · Plant X is a fictional company. Synthetic data only.
shell.ai_use: Invoices are read by OCR (AI optional, off in this demo); rules decide.
